summary: Iteration 2 verified the four new features (3D focus, Höhen-Heatmap, Session-Replay, Daten-Export) plus regression of existing endpoints. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass, including the new GET /api/sessions/{session_id}/frames (returns full-shape frames sorted by seq asc, no _id/_pk leakage, respects limit) and regression on /config, /config/mode, /config/band, /config/weights, /sessions, /telemetry/latest, /telemetry/history, /insights/analyze, WS /api/ws/telemetry (connected+telemetry+set_mode). Frontend: header/WS LIVE, navigation across all 5 tabs (nav-dashboard/nav-field3d/nav-diagram/nav-replay/nav-sessions) works. Dashboard export-csv-btn and export-json-btn become enabled after live frames arrive and trigger real file downloads (telemetry_<ts>.csv/.json). Field3D canvas renders; toggle-heatmap flips label 'Heatmap AN' <-> 'Heatmap AUS'; reset-focus is disabled initially (no focus). Replay: session dropdown auto-selects a session with frames (87 frames loaded); replay-playpause advances frames (verified Frame 1 -> Frame 4 after ~1.5s play); replay-stepforward/stepback move by ±1; all four speed buttons (0.5/1/2/4) present and clickable; replay-fusion, ConfidenceGauge, VirtualScannableField, BubblesCore, ModelScorePanels re-render as idx changes; replay-scrubber max reflects frames.length-1; Replay export CSV/JSON downloads verified.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' fires because a Radix/shadcn <SelectItem>-style child structure appears inside a native <select>. Trace points to option content; visually harmless but it is a real React DOM nesting warning.

action_items: (Optional) Silence '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning coming from Replay session <select> or an unrelated shadcn Select on the page.
(Optional) StrictMode double-WS from iteration_1 was NOT re-verified; if not yet fixed, telemetry-stream key warnings may still fire.
critical_code_review_comments: Field3D.jsx: EntityMesh onClick uses e.stopPropagation() correctly and CameraRig lerps camera+target smoothly - clean implementation. HeatDisc opacity uses AdditiveBlending, looks great.
Replay.jsx: setInterval timer correctly cleared on unmount / speed change; auto-stops at last frame. Good.

ExportButtons.jsx: URL.revokeObjectURL is called immediately after a.click() - on some browsers the download may not have started yet, causing an aborted download. Consider revoking after a short setTimeout or on window 'blur'. Not observed in this test (downloads worked).
server.py: /api/sessions/{session_id}/frames has no upper bound on 'limit' - a client could request millions. Consider clamp min(limit, 5000).
server.py: still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') (carried over from iteration 1).
seed_data_creation: none (telemetry loop persists frames automatically; used active session which had 87+ frames)
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3D entity mesh click via Playwright mouse.click on canvas at various offsets did NOT hit a WebGL mesh (raycast fails from 2D coords). This is a Playwright/WebGL limitation, not an app defect - reset-focus stayed disabled. Manual/keyboard interaction with three.js is not reliably scriptable; the onClick handler itself is wired correctly per code review. Everything else was exercised. Dashboard and Replay ExportButtons downloads were verified via page.expect_download and produced real files.
rca of the issue: n/a - no blocking issue found this iteration.
